headline: Saraf and Partners assists Anant Raj on demerger of data center business into standalone listed entity
sum: Anant Raj Limited (ARL) has announced a landmark composite corporate restructuring involving the merger of Anant Raj Cloud Private Limited into ARL, followed by the demerger of its data centre and cloud business to Ashok Cloud Private…
detail: Anant Raj Limited (ARL) has announced a landmark composite corporate restructuring involving the merger of Anant Raj Cloud Private Limited into ARL, followed by the demerger of its data centre and cloud business to Ashok Cloud Private Limited (ACPL) and the proposed listing of ACPL as a dedicated digital infrastructure platform. Saraf and Partners acted as the legal counsel to Anant Raj Limited. The transaction team was led by Vaibhav Kakkar (Senior Partner) and Debarpan Ghosh (Partner), with support from Anuj Garg (Senior Associate), Associates Ishaan Gupta and Nikhil Surana. The competition team led by Akshayy S Nanda (Partner), with Rohan Malhotra (Associate) and Rahul Dhingra…
